source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page captured as original HTML on 2026-11-11; 25 non-empty source sections extracted from the archived page. notes: Technical specifications in sections are transcribed from the model-specific Apple technical-specification page.

Model number and introduction-date evidence is retained from Apple's separate identification page: https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823 (archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html).

This page covers iPod shuffle (4th generation); variant-specific release dates and identifiers should be read from the separate identification-page evidence, not inferred from this technical-specification page.

The first section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page; its source_url and source_file are attached directly to that section. Remaining sections are extracted from the model-specific technical-specification page and carry that page's source_url and source_file individually.

sections.heading: iPod touch and the Environment
sections.source_text:
Apple takes a complete product life cycle approach to determining our environmental impact. Learn more
iPod touch is designed with the following features to reduce its environmental impact:
Mercury-free LED-backlit display
Arsenic-free display glass
Brominated flame retardant-free
PVC-free
Recyclable aluminum enclosure
Apple and the Environment
Read our Product Environmental Reports for detailed information on the environmental performance of every Apple product.
Available space is less and varies due to many factors. A standard configuration uses approximately 10GB to 12GB of space (including iOS and preinstalled apps) depending on the model and settings. Preinstalled apps use about 4GB, and you can delete these apps and restore them.
Weight varies by configuration and manufacturing process.
For iPod touch with Maps, the Maps application provides your approximate location using information based on your proximity to known Wi-Fi networks (when on and available). The more accurate the available information, the smaller the circle identifying your position on the map. The feature is not available in all areas. Known Wi-Fi networks are predominantly in urban areas. In order to provide your location, data is collected in a form that does not personally identify you. If you do not want such data collected, do not enable the feature. Not enabling the feature will not impact the functionality of your iPod touch.
Standard Dynamic Range video content only.
Siri may not be available in all languages or in all areas, and features may vary by area. Internet access required.
Requires connection to power.
Testing conducted by Apple in April 2019 using preproduction iPod touch (7th generation) hardware and software. The playlist consisted of 358 unique audio tracks purchased from the iTunes Store (256-Kbps AAC encoding); video content was a repeated 2-hour 23-minute movie purchased from the iTunes Store. All settings were default except: Audio was routed to wired headphones; Wi-Fi was associated with a network; the Wi-Fi feature Ask to Join Networks and Auto-Brightness were turned off. Battery tests are conducted with specific iPod units; actual results may vary. Battery life and number of charge cycles vary by use and settings. See www.apple.com/uk/batteries for more information.
Remote and mic not included.
iPod and iTunes are for legal or rightholder-authorized copying only. Don’t steal music.
